title: Define agent hook, run-context, response event, and tool-image-cache boundaries
description: TASK-025 and TASK-028 created the runner, request decorator, persona, tool-loop policy, and context-window boundaries. AstrBot still separates run context, hooks, response/message event shapes, and tool-image cache behavior around the agent. Rust should define those boundaries before tool-loop, multimodal, live feedback, and plugin hooks expand the runner directly.

files.change: Define hook dispatch, run-context state, response event DTOs, agent message wrappers, and tool-image cache ports.
Keep pipeline stages invoking agent hooks through typed ports rather than embedding agent side effects.

criteria: AgentRunner does not own hook dispatch, response event streaming, or tool image cache internals.
Plugin hooks can observe agent lifecycle through typed events.
Multimodal/tool-loop/live-feedback work has destinations outside provider adapters and pipeline stages.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-agent && cargo test -p astrbot-pipeline && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
